scenes.heading: Title Card
scenes.narration: The water cycle shows how water moves through Earth's systems. It starts with evaporation and ends with collection.

steps.narration: Sun heats water from oceans and lakes.
steps.note: Water turns into vapor and rises into air.

steps.narration: Water vapor cools and forms clouds.
steps.note: Vapor turns into tiny droplets in the sky.

steps.narration: Clouds release rain or snow when full.
steps.note: Water falls back to Earth's surface.

steps.narration: Rain flows into rivers, lakes, and oceans.
steps.note: Water returns to bodies of water.

scenes.heading: Water Cycle Process
scenes.narration: Water moves in a cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection. This keeps Earth’s water balanced.

steps.narration: Sun heats surface water, turning it into vapor.
Vapor cools and forms tiny droplets in clouds.
When clouds get heavy, water falls as rain or snow.
steps.note: Water returns to land and oceans.

steps.narration: Water flows into rivers, lakes, and back to oceans.
